rules: B0 contains only Claims directly adopted from external literature and unproved in the paper.
Every Claim in B0 must have a non-empty, audited sourceReference and an accurate sourcePath.
Claims proved within the paper must NOT enter B0.
Facts (definitions, calculations, algorithms) do not require proof and must NOT enter B0.

forbiddenRelations.description: Proof inferences must form a strict Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG); no inference may depend on its conclusion directly or indirectly.
Inferences of kind 'organization' must strictly connect Facts to a Fact and must be grounded in textual fact groupings.
loopTargetEntryId must point to the paper's principal mathematical target (paper:thm:gluing-isomorphism), never to boundary lemmas.
Must not contain Alpha legacy fields (entryKind, candidate_entry, claim_status, review_state) in Gamma native entries.
